intro: Decision science, negotiation, professional ethics, and crisis decision-making.

sections.title: A perspective shaped by experience
paragraphs: Ching-Pu Chen is a professor in Yuan Ze University’s Department of Social and Policy Sciences and Director of the International Bachelor Program in Strategic Communication. He also leads the university’s International Academy.
His areas of expertise connect decision science with professional ethics, negotiation, public policy, and crisis management. He holds a doctorate in Decision Sciences from Harvard University.

Professor Chen’s previous university leadership roles include directing global affairs and international cooperation. His professional experience also includes leadership of the Chunghua Negotiation Management Association.
